# PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)

PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) is a Danish local psychiatric clinic that appears repeatedly in the ADHD-databasens 2024 årsrapport (ADHD Database's 2024 annual report), a national quality-monitoring document that tracks how psychiatric departments across Denmark perform on a set of standardized treatment indicators for ADHD patients.

The clinic is named among the three top-performing departments on Indicator 8, which measures the share of treatment courses in which patients began ADHD-related psychoeducation within 120 days of starting treatment — a measure where national compliance was only 36% against a 90% target [^src1]. Tre afdelinger nåede en andel på/over 80 %: PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) (83 %), PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens (82 %) og PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt (80 %) [^src1], placing PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) alongside [[pho-klinik-1-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] and [[pmi-klinik-depression-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]] as the only departments reaching or exceeding the 80% mark on that indicator.

The clinic's most notable result concerns Indicator 10, which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of starting treatment. This was the first year this indicator was reported nationally, and results across the country were weak — only 37% compliance nationally against a development target of 90%, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52% [^src2]. Against that backdrop, PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) stood out: it recorded 38 out of 47 relevant treatment courses meeting the criterion, a rate of 81% (confidence interval 67–91) [^src2]. This was the highest result among all lokalpsykiatri (local psychiatry) clinics nationally, though it still fell short of the 90% development goal [^src2].

The clinic also appears in the data for Indicator 11, which tracks whether adult patients were on ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a treatment package — again the first time this indicator was compiled for adults following the ADHD database's 2024 expansion to include adult patients [^src3]. Here, PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) recorded 35 out of 47 courses meeting the standard, a rate of 74% (confidence interval 60–86) [^src3].

Taken together, these figures position PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) as a comparatively strong performer within the local psychiatry segment on several new 2024 ADHD quality indicators, even as the broader national picture shows widespread shortfalls tied partly to registration practices and data quality issues at outpatient clinics and private hospitals [^src2].
